workflow: A549 L2 cells were metabolically labeled with “medium” heavy 13C6-arginine and D4-lysine, while L6 cells were labeled with heavy 13C615N4-arginine and 13C615N2-lysine (Cambridge Isotope Laboratories, USA). L0 cells were cultured with “light” amino acids.
Samples were digested overnight at 37 °C with trypsin, desalted and labeled by a 10-plex tandem mass tag (TMT) labeling reagent (Cat. #90110, Thermo Scientific, USA)
For SILAC quantification, multiplicity was set to triple SILAC labelling (Lys+0/Arg+0, Lys+4/Arg+6, Lys+8/Arg+10).
For TMT data, TMT 10-plex (+229.1629 Da) on lysine and N-terminus were added as static modifications.
